notes.title: Optimize updates
notes.content:
2021.4.27 We have greatly optimized and fixed a large number of BUGs for thegame. 

1. The balance of the game made a new debugging, re-optimized inside more than 100 kinds of weapons damage, attack speed energy balance and so on.
2. Volcanic, forested areas of the collision is no longer wrong.
3. Increased refresh rate of properties tank, including light properties, fire properties, ice properties, grass properties, dark properties, rock properties, water properties.
4. The AI of monsters and companions is optimized.
In addition, we will increase the style of the tank in the near future.

notes.title: 2021.3.17 The Updated content
notes.content:
1. Added a new guide mission.
  2. Solved the problem of control companions and missile launch lag.
  3. Added the frequency of cannon attack of the main battle tank controlled by the player in order to prevent the experience from being affected by the lack of energy of the weapon and the player not firing bullets, which also weakened the difficulty of the game in disguise (there are five difficulty levels in the game, if you think the difficulty is too easy, you can adjust it at any time in the settings of the game screen).
